1.text: Amanutse kuri uwo musozi, abantu benshi baramukurikira.

2.text: Maze haza umubembe aramwegera, aramupfukamira aramubwira ati “Mwami, washaka wabasha kunkiza.”

4.text: Uwo mwanya ibibembe bye birakira. Yesu aramubwira ati “Wirinde ntugire uwo ubwira, ahubwo genda wiyereke umutambyi, uture n'ituro Mose yategetse ribabere ikimenyetso cyo kubahamiriza.”

5.text: Ageze i Kaperinawumu, haza umutware utwara umutwe w'abasirikare aramwinginga ati

6.text: “Mwami, umugaragu wanjye aryamye mu nzu yararemaye, arababaye cyane.”

8.text: Umutware w'abasirikare aramusubiza ati “Mwami, ntibinkwiriye yuko winjira mu nzu yanjye, ahubwo tegeka gusa, umugaragu wanjye arakira.

9.text: Kuko nanjye ndi umuntu utwarwa n'abandi, mfite abasirikare ntwara. Iyo mbwiye umwe nti ‘Genda’ aragenda, nabwira undi nti ‘Ngwino’ akaza, nabwira umugaragu wanjye nti ‘Kora iki’ akagikora.”

10.text: Yesu abyumvise aratangara, abwira abamukurikiye ati “Ndababwira ukuri yuko ntabwo nari nabona kwizera kungana gutya, habe no mu Bisirayeli.

11.text: Ndababwira yuko benshi bazaturuka iburasirazuba n'iburengerazuba, bakicarana na Aburahamu na Isaka na Yakobo mu bwami bwo mu ijuru,

12.text: ariko abana bo muri burya bwami bazirukanirwa mu mwijima hanze, ari ho bazaririra bakahahekenyera amenyo.”

13.text: Yesu abwira uwo mutware ati “Nuko genda bikubere nk'uko wizeye.”Umugaragu we akira uwo mwanya.

14.text: Yesu ajya mu nzu ya Petero, abona nyirabukwe aryamye arwaye ubuganga,

15.text: amukora ku kuboko ubuganga bumuvamo, arabyuka aramugaburira.

16.text: Nimugoroba bamuzanira abantu benshi batewe n'abadayimoni, yirukanisha abadayimoni itegeko gusa, akiza abari barwaye bose,

17.text: kugira ngo ibyavuzwe n'umuhanuzi Yesaya bisohore ngo “Ubwe ni we watwaraga ubumuga bwacu, akikorera n'indwara zacu.”

18.text: Kandi Yesu abonye abantu benshi bamugose, ategeka ko bambuka bakajya hakurya.

19.text: Umwe mu banditsi araza aramubwira ati “Mwigisha, ndagukurikira aho ujya hose.”

20.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Ingunzu zifite imyobo n'ibiguruka mu kirere bifite ibyari, ariko Umwana w'umuntu ntafite aho kurambika umusaya.”

21.text: Undi wo mu bigishwa be aramubwira ati “Databuja, banza undeke ngende mpambe data.”

22.text: Yesu arambwira ati “Nkurikira, reka abapfuye bihambire abapfuye babo.”

23.text: Yikira mu bwato, abigishwa be bajyana na we.

24.text: Umuyaga uba mwinshi mu nyanja, ubwato bwabo burengerwa n'umuraba wisuka muri bwo, ariko we yari asinziriye.

26.text: Arababaza ati “Ni iki kibateye ubwoba, mwa bafite kwizera guke mwe?” Maze arabyuka acyaha umuyaga n'inyanja, biratuza rwose.

27.text: Abantu baratangara bati “Uyu ni muntu ki? Umuyaga n'inyanja na byo biramwumvira!”

28.text: Amaze gufata hakurya mu gihugu cy'Abagadareni, ahura n'abantu babiri batewe n'abadayimoni bava mu mva, bari abasazi cyane bituma ari nta watinyuka kunyura muri iyo nzira.

29.text: Barataka cyane bati “Duhuriye he, Mwana w'Imana? Mbese uje hano kutwica urupfu n'agashinyaguro, igihe cyacu kitaragera?”

30.text: Hirya yabo hari umugana w'ingurube nyinshi zirisha.

31.text: Abadayimoni bazibonye baramwinginga bati “Nutwirukana utwohereze muri uriya mugana w'ingurube.”

32.text: Arabasubiza ati “Nimugende.” Babavamo baragenda, bajya muri izo ngurube. Umugana wose wirukira ku gacuri, zisuka mu nyanja zipfira mu mazi.

33.text: Abungeri bazo barahunga, binjiye mu mudugudu bavuga ibyo babonye byose, n'iby'abari batewe n'abadayimoni.

34.text: Abo muri uwo mudugudu bose bajya gusanganira Yesu, bamubonye baramwinginga ngo ave mu gihugu cyabo.
